description: Fail-closed media applicability and rendered-state evidence for every delivered portal surface. Supporting media endpoints are never promoted to visible fallback UX evidence.

surfaces.rationale: Authentication forms render text, controls and validation feedback without a repository-managed image or editorial-media consumer.
Password recovery, reset and authenticated password-change forms render text and controls without repository-managed media.
The MFA provisioning QR code is security enrollment output, not EditorialMedia, Wiki content or a managed-image fallback surface governed by this contract.
Account overview and provisioning states render textual status, controls and identifiers without repository-managed media consumption.
The Hunt Session Analyzer renders owner-private textual metrics, tables and controls without repository-managed editorial media.
Character creation and public visibility preferences render forms and textual state without repository-managed media.
Sessions, privacy, email recovery, recovery keys and termination surfaces render security controls and text without managed editorial media.
Character profile preferences and public visibility controls do not render repository-managed editorial media.
The public home and SEO shell currently render composed text, navigation and metadata without a managed-image consumer.
Current CMS news and managed-page contracts render escaped or sanitized text content and do not establish managed-image rendering.
Public highscores, characters, guilds, online and server views render tabular or textual runtime data without repository-managed media.
Core administration, RBAC, CMS metadata and audit views do not currently establish a rendered managed-image consumer.
Localization editing and route-preserving locale switching do not independently consume or render managed media.
Community rankings, profiles, deaths, guild discovery and policy states render text and tables without repository-managed media.
Download artifacts are externally linked and are explicitly not uploaded, fetched, proxied or rendered as managed media by the portal.
Updater diagnostics, policy controls and withdrawal actions render bounded trust-state text and controls; they do not consume repository-managed media or create an image fallback surface.
Current event fields and browser evidence establish textual calendar and administration content without a repository-managed image contract.
Announcements are escaped plain-text home composition and do not expose a managed-image contract.
Support and legal content establish approved links and textual publication states, not managed-image rendering.
The current Marketplace catalogue and detail views render character-auction facts, filters and prices without repository-managed image fields.
Watch, bid, wallet reservation and settlement screens render transactional text and controls without managed media consumption.
Administrator wallet adjustment, ledger and recovery surfaces render privileged textual data and controls without managed media.
Payment history and checkout-return presentation render bounded financial state, identifiers and controls without repository-managed media.
Payment reconciliation administration renders bounded provider-state codes, identifiers and controls without repository-managed media.
The deterministic test-provider ingress is a JSON transport endpoint and has no rendered managed-media state.
Support cases, moderation actions, private notes, appeals and notifications render text and controls without repository-managed images.
The delivered Game Catalog projections render item, creature and loot facts as text and links; no sprite or managed-image field is currently delivered.
Administrator Game Catalog inspection renders snapshot, finding and diff metadata without a user-visible managed-image consumer.

surfaces.rationale: Protected content, thumbnail and signed-preview routes deliver media bytes for Wiki and Editorial Media consumers. Their HTTP authorization and integrity behavior supports, but never substitutes for, rendered fallback evidence.

nonclaims: This contract proves only the delivered managed-media consumers and does not create image requirements for non-media surfaces.
Supporting endpoint responses are not treated as visible fallback UX evidence.
Parent Issue #326 remains open for the remaining exhaustive state matrix.
No staging, production or Canary behavior is claimed.
